lines.text: First, let us make a power gem!

lines.speaker: bavmorda
lines.text: Listen! Walk to the letter that makes this sound.

lines.speaker: bavmorda
lines.text: Walk on the letters, then pick the right door!

lines.speaker: bavmorda
lines.text: Read the word, then walk to its picture!

lines.speaker: bavmorda

lines.speaker: bavmorda
lines.text: That one is ticklish! Try again!

lines.speaker: bavmorda

lines.speaker: bavmorda

lines.speaker: bavmorda
lines.text: That was close! We need a plan!

lines.speaker: bavmorda
